personality_one_liner: A fast, legible, and highly operational white-ledger system that builds trust through precise numbers and clear grouping.

spacing.rule: Generous hit targets for single-handed use while standing or moving. Use padding to group related data tightly, with wider margins separating discrete sections.

do's: Use glass effect on the bottom tab bar.
Use glass effect on sticky primary CTAs (e.g., 'Save Trip') anchored at the bottom.
Use subtle blur on sticky date headers when scrolling through the ledger.
dont's: Do not use glass on data cards or ledger rows. Maintain solid contrast for readability.

screens.name: Home / Today
screens.purpose: A single-screen summary displaying today's operational pulse and net P&L with immediate entry access.

states.loading: Skeleton rows for metrics and list.
states.empty: Illustration of a truck with 'No trips recorded today' and a primary CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky top date navigator. Hero card at the top displaying large 'Net P&L' using Space Grotesk. Profit in success color, loss in error color. Below hero: 2x2 grid of compact metric cards (Trips, Cash In, Cash Out, Pending). Followed by a chronologically ordered transaction/trip list for the day. Floating FAB (glassmorphism base) for '+' quick add, anchored in the bottom right.

screens.name: Add Trip Form
screens.purpose: High-speed data entry optimized for one-handed use under 20 seconds.

states.error: Inline red validation text under failed fields.

screens.layout: Single-column scrolling list. Labels always visible above fields. Sectioned into: 1. Trip Info (Vehicle, Driver - use BottomSheet pickers, not dropdowns), 2. Financials (Freight, Advance, Pending - use numeric keypads). 3. Expenses grid. The 'Save & Add Another' and 'Save' buttons must be housed in a sticky bottom container that persists over the scroll view. Use 44x44pt hit targets.

screens.name: Monthly P&L
screens.purpose: Detailed financial breakdown with collapsible line items.

states.empty: No data for this month illustration.

screens.layout: Month/Year selector at top. Top section shows a simple trend line chart or bar chart. Below is a structured tabular list. Grouped by Income, Variable Overheads, Fixed Overheads. Right-aligned amounts to allow visual scanning of decimal places. Emphasize totals using borderStrong top dividers.

screens.name: Pending Freight
screens.purpose: Receivables tracking with ageing buckets to manage outstanding money.
screens.layout: Top segmented control (All, 0-30 days, 30-60, 60+). List of parties with pending amounts. Each card shows the Party name, total pending (bold error color), and a sub-list of associated Trip IDs. Tap to reveal payment collection CTA.

empty_state.alt: Clean abstract white shape for empty data

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. Do NOT inject generic purple/blue colors; rely on graphite (#111827), green (#059669), and red (#DC2626) to communicate trust and financial clarity.
Implement the 'Space Grotesk' font specifically for numeric displays (P&L, amounts, Indian Rupee ₹ format) to give a structured, tabular feel to numbers, and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all text.
Ensure 'Add Trip' form has a sticky 'Save' CTA anchored to the bottom over the scroll view, allowing instant access to submission without scrolling to the bottom.

On the Home Screen, ensure the Hero card clearly distinguishes profit and loss with large typography and the designated success/error colors. Do not decorate with unnecessary charts on the today screen; numbers are the priority.
Enforce large 44x44pt tap targets and use numeric keypads explicitly for all amount input fields.
Implement Indian Rupee formatting (e.g. ₹1,23,456) for all numeric values.
Always wrap interactive elements in Pressable (not TouchableOpacity) and wire up haptics for primary button presses, toggles, and picker selections.
